подтема: Personal Intelligence: короткий промпт с «me / my family» вместо загрузки фото
title_en: Use short personal prompts with Personal Intelligence
content_en: Use Personal Intelligence to create more relevant, personal images from the user's own photo library, with no manual uploads or long prompts: write a simple prompt about the user's own life. The app fills in the blanks: it pulls the right context from the connected apps, and the labels of people and pets in the library provide the context that makes the images feel truly the user's own.
applies_when_en: A prompt in the Gemini app about the user (me, my family, my house, my cat) from a user with Personal Intelligence and connected apps (Google Photos with people and pet labels); a long description of appearance and tastes can be skipped.
not_applies_when_en: Personal Intelligence is not connected (API, AI Studio, other products, another account) or there are no connected apps or labels: then "me" means nothing and an explicit reference is needed; the sources describe only the Gemini app with connected apps.
caveats_en: The context is integrated directly with Nano Banana 2 (models: nb2).
To create images of other people from Google Photos, make sure their face group is named (models: unspecified).
Because Gemini can pull actual images of the user from Google Photos, manual photo uploads are no longer needed when prompting (models: unspecified).
canaries_en: In the Gemini app, draw me and my dog at the beach
Create a picture of my family on vacation from my Google Photos

подтема: Описывать нужную правку обычными словами (Google Photos, Lens)
title_en: Describe wanted edits in natural language
content_en: Describe the wanted edits in natural language, as a short edit instruction (remove an object, restore an old photo); personalized fixes to people in the photo, such as removing accessories or fixing an expression, can be requested too.
applies_when_en: A photo needs fixing (remove an object, restore an old picture, fix a smile) and the prompt is written as a short edit instruction.
not_applies_when_en: Generation from scratch without a source photo, which is not editing.
forbids_in_output_en: Put on a fun Christmas sweater
Make your photo look like instant film with flash
Put me in a dramatic black and white photo
caveats_en: Personalized edits remove accessories or fix a grin and everyone still looks like themselves (models: unspecified).
In Lens Create mode: try a suggested prompt or snap a picture and describe the edits wanted (models: unspecified).
A Lens demo names the target style by a trend label: a bedroom photo reimagined using the "dopamine decor" trend (models: nb25).

Photo-app "Create with AI" templates are worded as short imperative edit requests: "Put on a fun Christmas sweater", "Turn into a collectible figurine", "Make your photo look like instant film with flash", "Put me in a dramatic black and white photo" (models: unspecified).
canaries_en: Remove the power lines from my photo
Restore this faded old family picture
Take the hat off the person in this photo

подтема: Своя инструкция к Video Overview: сузить фокус на часть источника и назвать акценты
title_en: Custom Video Overview instructions set focus
content_en: When customizing a Video Overview, add a custom instruction that narrows the video to specific parts of the sources and names what to focus on.
applies_when_en: The prompt steers a NotebookLM Video Overview built from documents: which sections of the sources to focus on and what to emphasize.
not_applies_when_en: The prompt is about the look of the frame (style, light, composition): the custom instructions control the content, while the style in Video Overviews is chosen by a preset.
forbids_in_output_en: Focus only on the cost analysis sections of the business plan
Convert these recipes into an easy-to-follow video focusing on the prep time and cooking steps.
caveats_en: The custom instruction is addressed to NotebookLM; the Video Overview visuals are made with Nano Banana, Gemini 2.5 Flash Image (models: unspecified).

title_en: Ask NotebookLM to polish existing slide decks
content_en: To polish an existing presentation, upload the slides to NotebookLM and ask it to enhance aesthetics, apply brand colors or incorporate visuals from the sources; for an existing draft of a deck, ask NotebookLM to create more visually appealing slides, even in a certain style of color palette.
applies_when_en: A finished deck or draft must be made prettier, on brand or in a given palette.
not_applies_when_en: A single image through the API: there is no slide upload and no NotebookLM agents.
needs_from_prompt_en: the existing slides or deck draft
caveats_en: Slide Decks in NotebookLM run on Nano Banana Pro (models: pro).
canaries_en: Make my uploaded slide deck look more polished
Restyle my presentation draft in our brand colors

подтема: Slides (Help me visualize): для большего контроля — более подробный промпт и явный тип вывода
title_en: For more control, write detailed prompts
content_en: For more control, use the Help me visualize sidebar to enter more detailed prompts and select a specific output style (slide, image, infographic), then refine the results with the built-in advanced image editing capabilities.
applies_when_en: In Google Slides a short request does not give the intended result, and finer control over the image, infographic or slide is wanted.
not_applies_when_en: A quick redesign of a finished slide without a prompt (Beautify this slide), or generation outside Slides.
canaries_en: In Google Slides, create a detailed infographic slide about our quarterly results
Help me visualize this slide as an image with more control over the result

terms.значение_en: An explicit choice of the result type in the Help me visualize side panel
